summary: DaveHax demonstrates a density experiment, layering syrup, coloured water and oil in a glass and dropping in objects (metal nut, grape, plastic bottle top, sponge) to see where each settles.

questions.question: What type of oil is named on the label of the bottle poured into the glass?
In the end screen, which video title is listed at the top of the list on the right?
What colour is the piece of sponge the speaker drops into the glass at the end?
How long does the speaker say to leave the glass to settle after adding the oil?
